systems.Mg2Ni_region: Exposed Mg2Ni(100) region in the existing Mg/Mg2Ni interface, Mg36Ni6; not a free-standing single-phase Mg2Ni slab or pure Ni

limitations: One local dissociation path per selected surface; not a global orientation/transition-state search.
Mg2Ni-containing side uses an exposed alloy region supported on Mg; no free-standing Mg2Ni comparison is claimed.
No slab-thickness, k-mesh or dispersion convergence study is included; weak molecular physisorption may be sensitive.
Fixed bottom eight Mg atoms and dipole correction are new to both paths; all energies must use these new references, never old energy values.
No barrier is claimed before endpoints retain identity and CI-NEB passes image-force/electronic/normal-termination gates.
Finite-temperature, zero-point and transmission corrections, TS frequencies and downhill connectivity are not yet calculated.
